prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Icelandic woman — the personification of Reykjavik — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Reykjavik as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Reykjavik with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a university festival lane of booths under bunting and paper lanterns, a stall counter with hand-drawn signs without readable text and a small stage beyond
Season: summer — the light nights of late May to late July when the sun barely sets, cool fresh air around ten to fifteen degrees.
Time of day: the morning rush hour — low clean sunlight and the city's crowd hurrying to work; fresh low sunlight, long cool shadows.
Outfit: a daring adult cosplay of Reno from Final Fantasy VII — the costume's recognisable colours and parts, cut as a fitted strapless mini dress, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing, leaning back against a wall.
SUPPORT: her back rests against the wall.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the right of the frame; head turned with her body, the tip of her nose pointing toward the right of the frame; camera at her eye level; a soft out-of-focus object of the place sits in the near foreground at one edge of the frame; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand tucks hair behind her ear — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks toward the left of the frame.
EXPRESSION: one mouth corner lifted higher than the other, lips closed.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Costume: her outfit itself shows that game character — the costume's recognisable colours, shapes and parts at first glance, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit. She is a real woman wearing a cosplay of that character, not the character: her face, hair colour and body stay exactly as in the attached image — never the character's face, body, creature shape, logo or readable text. Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, armour or regalia from it, and not the object she holds in it; only the costume's own pieces.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

generation.note: Original PNG retained locally; only WebP and metadata committed.

observations: Festival costume portrait based on prescribed Reno mini-dress reinterpretation.
Blue-lavender hair and body consistent with selected reference; facial identity assessed where visible.
No obvious additional or disconnected limb in the visible composition.
Visible facial highlights and finely rendered finish exceed requested matte facial shading and visible painterly brushwork.
qa.cause: Style and facial finish drift toward rendered realism rather than requested painted matte-face treatment; preserved without regeneration.
